definitions.explanation: A soft, white food made by coagulating soy milk and pressing the curds into blocks.

examples.japanese: {冷奴|ひややっこ}は{冷|つめ}たい{豆腐|とうふ}の{料理|りょうり}です。
examples.english: Hiyayakko is a cold tofu dish.

examples.japanese: {味噌汁|みそしる}に{豆腐|とうふ}を{入|い}れる。
examples.english: Put tofu in the miso soup.

examples.japanese: {麻婆豆腐|マーボーどうふ}は{中華料理|ちゅうかりょうり}の{定番|ていばん}です。
examples.english: Mapo tofu is a classic Chinese dish.

notes:
Common types:
- {木綿|もめん}{豆腐|どうふ} (firm tofu) - denser, holds shape well
- {絹|きぬ}ごし{豆腐|どうふ} (silken tofu) - smoother, softer texture
- {焼|や}き{豆腐|どうふ} (grilled tofu) - for sukiyaki
- {揚|あ}げ{出|だ}し{豆腐|どうふ} (deep-fried tofu in broth)

Counted with {丁|ちょう}: {一丁|いっちょう} (one block).

Related foods: {厚揚|あつあ}げ (thick fried tofu), {油揚|あぶらあ}げ (thin fried tofu), {高野豆腐|こうやどうふ} (freeze-dried tofu).
